title: Senior Software Engineer, Authorization - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**

  
About JumpCloud®
  

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

  
  
**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

**What you’ll be doing:**
  
The Senior Software Engineer acts as a reliable driver of quality and velocity, ensuring seamless execution across time zones.
  

  
* Develop, test, and deploy scalable, secure, and exceptionally well-documented Go, NodeJS, or Python services. Ensure all code meets high standards for performance and maintainability, with an emphasis on reducing latency for global users
  
* Design and develop automated test cases for both new features and legacy services, ensuring that new code is covered and actively reduces regression risk. Champion the use of CI/CD gates to enforce quality standards automatically
  
* Partner with Product Management and UX across multiple time zones to refine requirements, assess technical feasibility during feature discovery, and ensure the engineering roadmap aligns with business value.
  
* Focus on defining alerts and runbooks that enable reliable, zero-downtime deployment capabilities for distributed operations
  
* Help the engineering team to improve processes, promoting the effective use of automated tools and leveraging AI to accelerate development cycles (e.g., code generation, test generation, dependency tracing)
  
  

  
**We’re looking for:**
  

  
* 8+ years of industry programming experience, with a proven track record of delivering end-to-end production quality, complex and scalable software products
  
* Proficiency in Go, NodeJS, and/or Python. Willingness to learn VueJS as needed for full-stack integration
  
* Deep understanding of core Auth/IAM technologies such as OAuth 2.0, OIDC (OpenID Connect), JWT, and IAM systems
  
* Aptitude for Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and cloud technology concepts
  
* Demonstrated ability to thrive in a geographically distributed team environment, relying on asynchronous communication, written documentation (GitOps), and meeting strict Definition of Done (DoD) practices
  
* Excellent organizational skills and technical leadership skills, capable of driving consensus and clear direction in a cross-functional environment, including the ability to facilitate effective decision-making across multiple time zones

  

**Where you’ll be working/Location:**

  

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

  
  

**You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.**

  
  

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

  
  

**Language:**

  

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

  
  

**Why JumpCloud?**

 

  

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  

  

 

  

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

  

 

  

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.  Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   

  

 

  

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

  
  

**Scam Notice:**

  

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

  
  

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. 2. Solid understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and ReactJS) and back-end development using Python frameworks (e.g., Django, Flask).

3. Experience working with databases (SQL/NoSQL) and creating efficient data models.

4. Knowledge of RESTful API design and integration.

5. Familiarity with version control tools (Git) and modern development practices (Agile, CI/CD).

6. Understanding of cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure is a plus.

It's a high growth role for candidates with strong problem solving skills, who can solve problems from first principles and help build software to solve and scale. You will be working with a small but highly nimble team to deliver results extremely efficiently.

description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through an intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and technology into a single System of Action. Founded in 1979 and headquartered in Miami, Florida, the company serves manufacturers across more than 100 countries in industries including automotive, consumer products, food and beverage, high technology, industrial equipment, and life sciences.
  
  
The platform is built on three core pillars:
**Redzone**
(frontline empowerment),
**Adaptive ERP**
(the intelligent backbone of manufacturing operations), and
**ChampionAI**
(Agentic AI purpose-built for manufacturing). Together, these enable manufacturers to achieve measurable productivity, resilience, and growth — in as little as 90 days.
  
  
**Job Description**
ChampionAI is QAD | Redzone's agentic platform, purpose-built for manufacturing and used across all business units. As a junior-level Engineer, you will join the core platform team to build new platform capabilities, help Applied AI teams ship Champion agents correctly, and directly build Champion agents for business-unit use cases.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build and ship features across the Champion platform repositories using trunk-based development with PR-gated merges.
* Improve developer experience through tooling, scaffolding, internal documentation, and onboarding paths for Applied AI engineers.
* Maintain and evolve the MCP tool server and agent infrastructure that business unit teams depend on.
* Identify and address friction points that slow down Champion development or deployment.
* Support BU Applied AI engineers in building, deploying, and operating Champions correctly.
* Review agent implementations for prompt quality, scope enforcement, auth configuration, and deployment setup.
* Contribute to internal engineering guides and skill documentation.
* Pair with BU engineers on first K8S manifest creation, database registration, and LaunchDarkly prompt rollout.
* Design and build Champion agents for BU use-cases when the platform team is directly engaged.
* Write and iterate on system prompts, tool bindings, and context injection for production agents.

**Qualifications**

**YOUR MISSION:**
**About the Organisation & Role:**
You will be part of the Core Commerce Platform organisation responsible for delivering the omnichannel commerce capabilities that power the purchase journey, inventory availability, delivery promise, order processing & fulfilment and post-purchase experiences across channels. The organisation plays a critical role in ensuring products are available to buy, orders can be fulfilled reliably, and commitments made to consumers are delivered consistently. Through a portfolio of commerce platform capabilities, the organisation enables seamless omnichannel experiences while supporting efficient, scalable, and resilient commerce operations across the global digital ecosystem.
  
  
As a Software Engineer, you will build the backend services that power omnichannel commerce capabilities. You will be responsible for technical design, implementation and validation. Working closely with the Lead Engineer and Engineering Manager, you will deliver low-latency services that support real-time consumer experiences.
  
  
**What you will do:**


* Develop and support scalable services for real-time inventory availability, allocation, and order promising across digital and physical commerce channels.
* Develop accurate Available-to-Sell calculations by combining on-hand, in-transit, reserved, allocated, and safety-stock inventory positions.
* Build order-promising capabilities that calculate reliable delivery and pickup estimates based on inventory location, fulfilment-node capacity, carrier options, shipping methods, and operational cut-off times.
* Implement inventory segmentation and buffer strategies, including safety stock and channel-specific allocations, to balance availability while minimizing overselling and underselling risks.
* Develop production-grade microservices using Java and Spring Boot, with a strong focus on scalability, resilience, maintainability, and operational performance.
* Build event-driven inventory processing using Kafka or similar messaging technologies to handle receipts, adjustments, reservations, releases, cancellations, and fulfilment updates in near real time.
* Integrate inventory and promising services with OMS, commerce, WMS, ERP, store, and fulfilment platforms to provide consistent availability across the order lifecycle.
* Ensure solutions are secure, observable, reliable, and resilient through strong engineering practices.
* Own well-defined features or components from design through production.
* Write clean, tested and maintainable code, participate in peer reviews, and maintain relevant technical documentation.
* Optimize performance, scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency through automation and proactive improvements.
* Support production services through monitoring, troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, contributing to reliability improvements.

* 4+ years of experience designing, developing and supporting enterprise-grade applications, preferably within commerce, order management, inventory or supply-chain domains.
* Hands-on software engineering experience with Java, Spring Boot and microservices architectures.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, event-driven architectures, messaging technologies and integration patterns.
* Experience building reliable, scalable, maintainable and production-grade backend services.
* Practical understanding of design patterns, data structures and algorithms.
* Experience with automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines and production support.
* Understanding of observability, reliability engineering and performance optimisation.
* Working knowledge of order lifecycle or inventory-management concepts such as availability, reservations, ATP, ATS, allocation or fulfilment.
* Experience integrating with OMS, WMS, ERP, commerce or fulfilment platforms will be an advantage.
* Experience configuring and extending Distributed Order Management Systems (OMS), with Fluent Commerce experience preferred.
* Experience with Kafka or equivalent messaging technologies.
* Experience using coding agents, LLMs or AI-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery and developer productivity.

**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD is building a world-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
  
  
**This hybrid position requires candidates to be based in Pune with 3-4 days of in-office collaboration per week.**
**Job Description**
**The Mission: What You'll Be Building**
You Will Be a Core Contributor In The Design, Development, And Implementation Of New Models And Procedures. You Will Provide Technical Guidance, Mentor Junior Team Members, And Leverage In-depth Professional Knowledge To Develop Solutions In Cloud-native Architectures, Microservices, And Agile Product Development. You Will Be Instrumental In Building The Next Generation Of Our Platform, Which Features Core Pillars Like
  
  

* Adaptive Applications: The intelligent backbone powering the manufacturing enterprise.
* Champion AI: Agentic AI for manufacturing that drives measurable productivity and growth.

**Your Impact/ What You Will Be Doing**

* Independent Design & Implementation: Independently design, implement, and lead the development and testing of scalable web application features. Take end-to-end ownership of critical components across modern frontend frameworks and robust backend services.
* Complex Problem Resolution: Provide solutions to complex issues in creative and effective ways. Proactively debug, diagnose, and resolve a wide range of complex technical issues and performance bottlenecks across the stack with limited guidance. Understand the interrelationships of different disciplines and apply this knowledge to system design.
* Technical Guidance & Mentorship: Serve as a subject matter expert to mentor junior engineers, lead complex cross-team code reviews, and help set quality and performance standards. Adapt style to differing audiences and often advise others on difficult matters.
* Code for Scale & Efficiency: Optimize existing code and system architecture for performance, scalability, and maintainability, translating complex product and technical requirements into clean, efficient, and working code.
* Strategic Collaboration: Engage in cross-functional collaboration with Product, QA, and DevOps to deliver world-class enterprise SaaS products used by global customers. Enhance relationships and networks with senior internal/external partners.
* Tactical Accountability: Determine methods and procedures on new assignments. Work is done independently and is reviewed at critical points.
* Degree: Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience: Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related professional software development experience.
* Location: This is an on-site opportunity based in Pune with 3-4 days work from the office. Only candidates willing to be based in Pune will be eligible.

**Qualifications**

* Mastery in Data Structures & Algorithms: A strong foundation, including a clear understanding of time and space complexity.
* OOP Fundamentals: A solid grasp of Object-Oriented Programming concepts is essential.
* Web Basics: Foundational knowledge of frontend technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and backend programming (Java, JavaScript/Node.js, or Python).
* Architectural Awareness: Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, and end-to-end application communication, as well as an awareness of databases (SQL/NoSQL) and data modeling.
* Version Control: Proficiency with Git.
* AI-Assisted Development: Working knowledge of coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot.
* DevOps Practices: Familiarity with DevOps workflows, release management, and continuous improvement principles.
* Cloud Platforms: Understanding of core AWS services across compute, storage, and networking for SaaS deployments.
* Cloud & Infrastructure Management: Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
* Containers & Orchestration: Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes for containerized microservices.
* Monitoring & Observability: Exposure to Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry for metrics and distributed tracing.
* CI/CD: Understanding of CI/CD pipelines to automate build, test, and deployment workflows.

**Additional Information**

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

**About QAD**
QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
  
  
QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.
  
  
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

* Build durable workflows with checkpoints, retries, idempotency keys, timeouts and

compensation for failed actions.
  
  

* Use multi-agent designs, such as a router with specialist agents, only where they measurably

beat a single agent.
  
  

* Integrate CRMs, ticketing systems and databases for actions such as complaint registration,

classification, routing, status updates and notifications, with warm human handoff.
  
  
**Voice agents**

* Build streaming pipelines that connect telephony (SIP, Twilio, Exotel) and WebRTC audio to ASR,

LLMs and TTS over WebSockets.
  
  

* Implement voice activity detection, turn detection, barge-in and cancellation so the agent stops

talking the moment a caller speaks.
  
  

* Set and hold latency budgets per hop (ASR, LLM, TTS, network), with a target of under [1 s] from

end of caller speech to first agent audio.
  
  

* Adapt agent behaviour for speech: short turns, confirmations before actions, and recovery from

mishearing.
  
  

* Support multilingual and code-switched calls, including language detection and matching TTS

voices.
  
  
**Evaluation**

* Build and maintain golden test sets that define the user goal, persona, expected tool calls and

pass criteria for each scenario.
  
  

* Run trajectory evals that check each step's tool choice, arguments and order, not just the final

answer.
  
  

* Run simulated-caller evals for voice: an LLM plays the caller, TTS voices it with accents, noise

and interruptions, and the agent is tested end to end over real audio.
  
  

* Score task success, tool-call correctness, policy compliance, hallucination, word error rate and

latency, using rule checks and LLM judges calibrated against human ratings.
  
  

* Gate releases in CI on eval results, block regressions, and turn every confirmed production

failure into a new test case.
  
  
**Backend and operations**

* Write async Python services (FastAPI, asyncio) with structured logging, tracing and metrics for

every agent run and conversation.
  
  

* Load-test concurrent sessions, find bottlenecks and keep p95 latency and per-task model cost

within budget.
  
  

* Protect sensitive data: authentication and authorisation, audit trails for agent actions, PII

redaction and tenant isolation.
  
  

* Ship with Docker and CI using staged releases and rollback, and troubleshoot live agents in

production.
  
  

* Work with product and delivery teams to turn client workflows into working agent integrations.

**Required Qualifications And Skills**

* Strong Python and backend skills: APIs, asyncio, WebSockets, structured error handling and

automated tests.
  
  

* Hands-on experience shipping LLM agents beyond a prompt demo: tool calling, state

management, RAG and failure handling in a real workflow.
  
  

* Sound judgement on agent design: when a fixed workflow beats an autonomous agent, single

versus multi-agent, and how to keep agents safe with permissions and guardrails.
  
  

* Working knowledge of a real-time voice stack: streaming ASR and TTS, VAD, turn-taking and the

trade-offs between latency and accuracy.
  
  

* Experience designing evaluations for LLM agents: test sets, trajectory and outcome metrics,

LLM-as-judge and regression tracking — and knowing when a metric is misleading.
  
  

* Ability to debug across services using logs, traces and recorded sessions to find where an agent

failed or slowed down.
  
  

* Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, Git, Docker and CI pipelines.
* Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience, with clear examples of

delivered work.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**

* Agent frameworks and orchestration tools such as LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Temporal or

MCP tool servers.
  
  

* Production voice agents on telephony (SIP, Twilio, Exotel) or WebRTC, with frameworks such as

LiveKit Agents or Pipecat.
  
  

* Speech providers such as Deepgram, Whisper, Google STT, ElevenLabs, Azure TTS or Cartesia,

and measuring their WER and latency on your own data.
  
  

* Indian-language and code-switched speech (Hindi, Telugu, Tamil and English).
* Queues, caching and event-driven systems (Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ), and load-testing tools such

as Locust or k6.
  
  

* Access controls, PII redaction and on-premises or restricted-network deployments.
* Other modalities, such as vision or document understanding (images, screenshots, scanned

forms), and combining them with voice or text in one agent.
  
  
**Success in the role**
Success means AI agents — voice, chat or back-office — that complete real business tasks reliably, with
  
  
evidence that they work and a codebase the team can build on. In your first six months, that looks like:
  
  

* Business outcomes: agents measurably resolve tasks without human help, cut handling time

and raise customer satisfaction for client use cases.
  
  

* Reliability: workflows recover from timeouts, tool failures and bad input; write actions are

never duplicated; every incident is traced to a cause and fixed.
  
  

* Evaluation culture: every release is gated by evals, metrics track what users actually experience,

and production failures flow back into the test sets.
  
  

* Performance and cost: latency and per-task model cost stay within agreed budgets as traffic

grows.
  
  

* Delivery: client requirements become working integrations on schedule, with clear handover to

product and delivery teams.
  
  

* Engineering quality: features are tested, observable, documented and easy for others to

maintain; you take an active part in code review and shared tooling.

title: Senior AI Engineer - Agentic AI and Voice Agents
description:
**Role Overview**
We are hiring a senior AI engineer to build and lead agentic AI systems: LLM agents that plan, call tools
  
  
and complete real business tasks end to end. You will build agents that hold live phone and web
  
  
conversations — streaming speech recognition, reasoning and tool calls, and speech synthesis in real
  
  
time. You will stay hands-on while setting technical direction, owning the evaluation system that proves
  
  
each agent works before every release, and helping a team of AI engineers move use cases from a demo
  
  
to a reliable, observable service that clients trust with their customers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Agentic systems**

* Design and build LLM agents that plan, call tools and complete multi-step business tasks across

voice, chat and back-office channels.
  
  

* Implement task and conversation state, memory and context management, retrieval (RAG) and

model routing between fast and more capable models.
  
  

* Define tool schemas and permissions, validate every tool call, and add human approval points

for high-impact actions.
  
  

* Build durable workflows with checkpoints, retries, idempotency keys, timeouts and

compensation for failed actions.
  
  

* Use multi-agent designs, such as a router with specialist agents, only where they measurably

beat a single agent.
  
  

* Integrate CRMs, ticketing systems and databases for actions such as complaint registration,

classification, routing, status updates and notifications, with warm human handoff.
  
  
**Voice agents**

* Build streaming pipelines that connect telephony (SIP, Twilio, Exotel) and WebRTC audio to ASR,

LLMs and TTS over WebSockets.
  
  

* Implement voice activity detection, turn detection, barge-in and cancellation so the agent stops

talking the moment a caller speaks.
  
  

* Set and hold latency budgets per hop (ASR, LLM, TTS, network), with a target of under [1 s] from

end of caller speech to first agent audio.
  
  

* Adapt agent behaviour for speech: short turns, confirmations before actions, and recovery from

mishearing.
  
  

* Support multilingual and code-switched calls, including language detection and matching TTS

voices.
  
  
**Evaluation**

* Build and maintain golden test sets that define the user goal, persona, expected tool calls and

pass criteria for each scenario.
  
  

* Run trajectory evals that check each step, tool choice, arguments and order, not just the final

answer.
  
  

* Run simulated-caller evals for voice: an LLM plays the caller, TTS voices it with accents, noise

and interruptions, and the agent is tested end to end over real audio.
  
  

* Score task success, tool-call correctness, policy compliance, hallucination, word error rate and

latency, using rule checks and LLM judges calibrated against human ratings.
  
  

* Gate releases in CI on eval results, block regressions, and turn every confirmed production

failure into a new test case.
  
  
**Backend and operations**

* Write async Python services (FastAPI, asyncio) with structured logging, tracing and metrics for

every agent run and conversation.
  
  

* Load-test concurrent sessions, find bottlenecks and keep p95 latency and per-task model cost

within budget.
  
  

* Protect sensitive data: authentication and authorisation, audit trails for agent actions, PII

redaction and tenant isolation.
  
  

* Ship with Docker and CI using staged releases and rollback, and troubleshoot live agents in

production.
  
  

* Work with product and delivery teams to turn client workflows into working agent integrations.

**Technical leadership**

* Own the architecture of agent and voice systems, document key decisions and explain trade-offs

to engineers, product and clients.
  
  

* Break client requirements into technical designs and delivery milestones, and assign work across

the team.
  
  

* Review code and designs, and set team standards for testing, evaluation, monitoring and

release.
  
  

* Mentor AI engineers through pairing, design reviews and feedback, and help them grow into

owning features end to end.
  
  

* Lead incident response for production issues, run blameless post-mortems and drive the fixes to

completion.
  
  
**Required Qualifications And Skills**

* Strong Python and backend skills: APIs, asyncio, WebSockets, structured error handling and

automated tests.
  
  

* Hands-on experience shipping LLM agents beyond a prompt demo: tool calling, state

management, RAG and failure handling in a real workflow.
  
  

* Sound judgement on agent design: when a fixed workflow beats an autonomous agent, single

versus multi-agent, and how to keep agents safe with permissions and guardrails.
  
  

* Working knowledge of a real-time voice stack: streaming ASR and TTS, VAD, turn-taking and the

trade-offs between latency and accuracy.
  
  

* Experience designing evaluations for LLM agents: test sets, trajectory and outcome metrics,

LLM-as-judge and regression tracking — and knowing when a metric is misleading.
  
  

* Ability to debug across services using logs, traces and recorded sessions to find where an agent

failed or slowed down.
  
  

* Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, Git, Docker and CI pipelines.
* Evidence of owning production services from design through operation, including reliability

under real traffic.
  
  

* Experience mentoring engineers, reviewing their work and leading technical decisions with

product or client stakeholders.
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience, with clear examples of

delivered work.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**

* Agent frameworks and orchestration tools such as LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Temporal or

MCP tool servers.
  
  

* Production voice agents on telephony (SIP, Twilio, Exotel) or WebRTC, with frameworks such as

LiveKit Agents or Pipecat.
  
  

* Speech providers such as Deepgram, Whisper, Google STT, ElevenLabs, Azure TTS or Cartesia,

and measuring their WER and latency on your own data.
  
  

* Indian-language and code-switched speech (Hindi, Telugu, Tamil and English).
* Queues, caching and event-driven systems (Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ), and load-testing tools such

as Locust or k6.
  
  

* Access controls, PII redaction and on-premises or restricted-network deployments.
* Other modalities, such as vision or document understanding (images, screenshots, scanned

forms), and combining them with voice or text in one agent.
  
  
**Success in the role**
Success means AI agents — voice, chat or back-office — that complete real business tasks reliably, with
  
  
evidence that they work, and a team that ships them with confidence. In your first six months, that looks
  
  
**Like**

* Business outcomes: agents measurably resolve tasks without human help, cut handling time

and raise customer satisfaction for client use cases.
  
  

* Reliability: workflows recover from timeouts, tool failures and bad input; write actions are

never duplicated; every incident is traced to a cause and fixed.
  
  

* Evaluation culture: every release is gated by evals, metrics track what users actually experience,

and production failures flow back into the test sets.
  
  

* Performance and cost: latency and per-task model cost stay within agreed budgets as traffic

grows.
  
  

* Delivery: client requirements become working integrations on schedule, with clear handover to

product and delivery teams.
  
  

* Engineering quality: features are tested, observable, documented and easy for others to

maintain.
  
  

* Team growth: architecture decisions are documented, engineers you mentor own features end

to end, and the team ships faster with fewer production issues.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you’ll own the architecture for production AI agents, set the standards teams follow to take AI from prototype to production, and mentor engineers along the way.
  
  
The hard problems here aren’t model demos. They’re reliable, safe, observable agent systems running in production: orchestration, memory, guardrails, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop control. You’ll be the person we trust to define what good looks like for AI engineering, and to make sure we build it responsibly.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the architecture for generative and agentic AI across our SaaS platform, and stay hands-on in the most complex, critical components.

* Architect RAG systems (including GraphRAG) that ground outputs in trusted data, and event-driven pipelines that trigger and coordinate agents at scale.

* Embed responsible-AI practices (privacy, bias mitigation, and auditability) directly into the reasoning and execution loops.
* Set architecture and code-quality standards, run design and code reviews, and mentor engineers; steer teams toward the right technologies and away from hype-driven choices.

* Build with AI coding tools and AI-assisted development to raise team velocity and quality, with disciplined review gates.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 10+ years in software engineering, with a strong track record shipping production SaaS and large-scale, cloud-native distributed systems (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

* Proven experience designing and shipping agentic AI systems: multi-agent orchestration, tool/function calling, agentic loops, memory, and autonomous execution, both embedded in a product and standalone.
* Depth in AI productization: guardrails, confidence-based logic, human-in-the-loop control, evaluation, observability, and reliability of agents in production.
* Experience building MCP servers (or equivalent tool layers), reusable agent skills, and event-driven architectures.
* Strong Python plus one of Go, Java, or TypeScript; fluency with modern AI and agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen).
* Practical experience building products with AI coding tools.
* Working knowledge of responsible AI: privacy, bias, and auditability.

**Nice to Have**

* Building, fine-tuning, and deploying Small Language Models (SLMs) for routing, extraction, classification, and tool-calling, including on-device/edge and privacy-sensitive deployments.
* MLOps / LLMOps experience and observability/tracing stacks (e.g., OpenTelemetry).
* Open-source contributions, patents, or publications in AI.
* MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

At Magnit, you’ll be joining an innovative, high-growth environment and can quickly make an impact to help transform the largest companies in the world. Magnit encourages employees to participate in giving back, and we will match employee contributions to favorite charities and support corporate volunteering hours to make a difference in your community!

Stay in touch, we will let you know when we have new positions on the team.

By combining deep technical expertise with business insight, they drive continuous improvement in how financial processes are executed—making it an exciting space for those who enjoy solving complex problems at the intersection of finance and technology.
  
  
**How You’ll Contribute**
This is a hands-on Oracle Fusion developer role embedded in the Financial Systems team. You own the technical implementation of Envestnet's billing-to-cash pipeline — building and maintaining AutoInvoice integrations from 5+ billing platforms, supporting Oracle RMCS revenue recognition configuration, and writing the SQL and REST integrations that keep AR accurate and audit-ready. You report to the Director, O2C and are their primary technical executor.
  
  
You work at the intersection of billing systems, Oracle AR, and revenue recognition. Given a billing platform API spec, you can design the AutoInvoice feed. Given an RMCS exception, you can trace it to its source in the Oracle data model. Given a new product launch, you can configure the transaction type and revenue recognition rule.
  
  
**Oracle Fusion AR & AutoInvoice**

* Own AutoInvoice interface implementations: map billing platform data to RA\\_INTERFACE\\_LINES\\_ALL and RA\\_INTERFACE\\_DISTRIBUTIONS\\_ALL, resolve validation errors, and ensure clean GL transfer
* Query Oracle AR tables (RA\\_CUSTOMER\\_TRX\\_ALL, AR\\_CASH\\_RECEIPTS\\_ALL, AR\\_PAYMENT\\_SCHEDULES\\_ALL, HZ\\_CUST\\_ACCOUNTS, etc.) for data validation, reconciliation, and ad hoc analysis
* Build and maintain AR REST API integrations for invoice creation, receipt application, and customer management
* Develop BIP reports and OTBI analyses for AR aging, billing reconciliation, and revenue reporting
* Build FBDI templates for bulk customer and transaction data loads
* Troubleshoot AutoInvoice errors using RA\\_INTERFACE\\_ERRORS\\_ALL and Oracle log analysis

**Oracle RMCS — Revenue Recognition**

* Support RMCS configuration: contract identification rules, performance obligation templates, and revenue recognition scheduling
* Write SQL queries against RMCS tables to validate revenue recognition outputs and trace exceptions
* Build RMCS data feeds and REST API integrations for contract import and satisfaction event processing
* Support extension of RMCS coverage to new product lines — map new transaction types to existing or new performance obligation configurations

**Billing Platform Integrations**

* Design and build REST/SOAP integrations between external billing platforms and Oracle AR AutoInvoice
* Write and maintain Workato recipes or integration scripts for billing-to-GL automation (in partnership with the Integration & Workato team)
* Validate billing platform API payloads against Oracle AR transaction type and AutoInvoice interface requirements
* Build reconciliation SQL to compare billing platform data against Oracle AR transaction records

**Oracle Subscription Management**

* Support Oracle Subscription Management Cloud configuration and REST API integration for SaaS billing arrangements
* Query subscription tables to validate contract and billing schedule accuracy

**Technical Skills Required**
**Shared Technical Foundation**

* Oracle SQL / PL/SQL: Query Oracle Fusion tables directly (GL, AP, AR, etc.); write SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and reporting; troubleshoot data issues at the table level
* Oracle REST APIs: Consume and test Oracle Fusion REST services for journal import, supplier/customer management, invoice processing, and period-close operations; read API documentation and design integration payloads
* Oracle SOAP Web Services: Work with older Oracle Fusion SOAP endpoints where REST is unavailable; construct and validate XML payloads
* Oracle BIP / OTBI: Build BI Publisher report templates (RTF, Excel); write OTBI analyses and dashboards; create data models over Oracle Fusion subject areas
* Oracle FBDI: Build and validate File-Based Data Import templates for bulk data loads; troubleshoot import errors using log files and Oracle table queries
* Oracle Integration Architecture: Understand Oracle Fusion module table structures and data flow well enough to design integrations, validate payloads, and diagnose errors without hand-holding

**O2C-Specific Technical Skills**

* AutoInvoice Interface: Working knowledge of RA\\_INTERFACE\\_LINES\\_ALL, RA\\_INTERFACE\\_DISTRIBUTIONS\\_ALL, and RA\\_INTERFACE\\_ERRORS\\_ALL — this is a hard requirement
* Oracle AR Table Schema: RA\\_CUSTOMER\\_TRX\\_ALL, AR\\_CASH\\_RECEIPTS\\_ALL, AR\\_PAYMENT\\_SCHEDULES\\_ALL, HZ\\_\\* customer model tables
* Oracle AR REST APIs: Invoice, receipt, customer, and adjustment REST services in Oracle Fusion AR
* RMCS Table Structures: Ability to query RMCS contract and satisfaction event tables to validate rev rec outputs
* Billing Platform APIs: Experience consuming REST or SOAP APIs from commercial billing platforms (Salesforce Billing, Zuora, NetSuite, or equivalent) and mapping to Oracle AR

**What You’ll Need To Bring**

* Hands-on Oracle Fusion AR technical development or integration experience
* Direct experience with Oracle AutoInvoice interface — table-level knowledge, error resolution, and integration design
* Oracle SQL proficiency: comfortable querying AR, customer model (HZ\\_\\*), and RMCS schemas
* Experience building REST or SOAP integrations with Oracle Fusion AR
* Experience building BIP reports or OTBI analyses over Oracle AR financial data
* Ability to independently consume a billing platform API spec and design an AutoInvoice feed

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Oracle Subscription Management Cloud integration experience
* Experience with Workato, MuleSoft, or equivalent iPaaS for billing automation

**The role:**

**Title:**

**Function:**
Technology

**Location:**
Bengaluru

**Why this role exists:**

The AI Engineer orchestrates the technical agents that produce code, tests, documentation and design mock-ups within a pod delivery model. The role translates product specifications into functional instructions for AI agents, running multiple agent workstreams in parallel across standard-complexity work while holding the pre-production commit gate for routine changes.

The role evolves how engineering is executed. AI agents carry a significant share of test generation, documentation and code execution, while the AI Engineer remains fully accountable for system design judgement, code review, quality and all commitments to production. The role relies on AI-driven test coverage, agent-supported execution and human-in-the-loop validation to maintain high release standards.

**Where you will make a difference:**

**In this role you will:**

**Agent Orchestration and Delivery:**

* Translate product specifications from the Product Orchestrator into functional specifications and instructions that AI agents can execute, clarifying intent where requirements are ambiguous.
* Run multiple technical agents in parallel across standard-complexity work (coding, test case generation, documentation and visual design mock-ups) sequencing outputs so one stream is usable by the next.
* Apply base context, security policies, architecture patterns and coding standards established by the platform team to every agent run.
* Improve agent workflows continuously, sharing prompt techniques, context improvements and automation patterns across pods.

**Review, Quality Engineering, and Commit Gate:**

* Hold the pre-production commit gate on routine changes, ensuring no code reaches production without thorough review.
* Perform fast and accurate reviews of generated code, tests and specifications, identifying subtle errors, logical defects or plausible but incorrect outputs.
* Confirm that instructions given to technical agents have been executed to the expected standard before committing code.
* Design and execute test strategy for assigned workstreams, including functional integration and regression testing, building on AI-generated test coverage and agent-supported execution.
* Identify, document, and track defects to resolution, communicating severity and coordinating fixes with technical and functional stakeholders.
* Own non-functional outcomes for assigned workstreams, including performance, resilience, accessibility and security, and confirm architectural fit before commit.
* Escalate complex, high-risk or major architectural changes to the Senior AI Engineer or Principal AI Engineer for higher-level review.

**Context, Documentation and Knowledge Management:**

* Verify that technical documentation exists and is accurate, maintaining documentation as an active input to subsequent agent runs rather than an after-the-fact record.
* Maintain knowledge artefacts for workstreams so future code and agent outputs draw on detailed, reusable domain context over time.
* Contribute domain knowledge back to shared context repositories in line with central standards managed by Context Engineers.
* Maintain clear system provenance to distinguish agent-generated components from human-authored code.

**Production Support and Continuous Improvement:**

* Identify, troubleshoot and resolve reported defects and incidents promptly across the platform domains the pod touches, including participation in on-call rotations.
* Support and maintain existing platforms, integrations and legacy services alongside agent-based delivery flows during technical transition periods.
* Execute production verification testing during post-deployment and hypercare periods, confirming release quality before handover to steady-state support.
* Report observed drift, hallucinations or specification failures in agent tooling to Agent Integrity Engineers.

* Engineering Leadership: Seek higher-level review for complex or high-risk changes from Senior AI Engineers, Principal Domain Engineers, and Associate Engineering Managers.
* Architecture and Context Teams: Apply platform context libraries and feed domain knowledge back to Context Engineers, Solution Architects and Domain Architects.
* Platform and Integrity Specialists: Report agent drift or hallucination to Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers and collaborate with Platform Engineers on workflows and permissions

**What success looks like:**

* Workstream Throughput: High throughput of reviewed and committed work delivered through parallel multi-agent workstreams.
* Commit Gate Quality: High review quality with minimal defects escaping to production, backed by rigorous verification.
* Context Artefact Accuracy: High standard of accurate, reusable documentation and context artefacts that continuously improve subsequent agent runs.
* Platform Stability: High stability, supportability, and swift issue resolution across owned platform domains and legacy components.
* Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks’ values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture.

**How you will lead:**

**Individual Contributor:**

* Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
* Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
* Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
* Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
* Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

**Qualifications and work experience:**

**Essential:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience: 6-8 years of software engineering experience, combining
  **full-stack development**
  with hands-on software
  **quality assurance**
  and testing across manual and automated methodologies.
* **System Design**
  Judgement: Demonstrated system design judgement to assess whether AI-generated code and technical output are fit for purpose, performant, and secure.
* **Agent Orchestration**

Caterpillar Trimble Control Technologies (CTCT) is a joint venture between Caterpillar and Trimble whose purpose is to transform the way heavy equipment customers shape the world with solutions that differentiate Caterpillar and Trimble.
  
  
As a V&V Tech Lead for CTCT grade control platform products, you will own the full verification and validation (V&V) lifecycle for your dedicated product team. Reporting through the validation organization, your primary objective is to ensure products meet end-user quality expectations by strategically shifting validation activities earlier in the development cycle using an end-to-end methodology. You will plan, direct, and execute these activities by leveraging team expertise, world-class evaluation methods, and enterprise best practices. Ultimately, your leadership will ensure that technical and program risks are accurately identified and quantified, and that all validation test plans are thorough, well-documented, and efficiently executed.
  
  
**Job Duties & Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy & Alignment**

* Customer & Feature Alignment: Collaborate directly with Product Owners to deeply understand product features, customer expectations, and ensure solutions are intuitive and user-friendly.
* Cross-Functional Bridge: Act as the vital link between Product and Development teams, translating feature requirements into clear, robust acceptance criteria and actionable V&V goals.
* Lifecycle Ownership: Fully understand the functionality and application of platform products, following them through their full lifecycle—from early development up to product deprecation.
* Feature Risk Assessment: Proactively identify and assess risks associated with specific features and functionalities, participating heavily in the product risk assessment process to ensure "Testing with a Purpose."

**Process & V&V Strategy**

* Test Pyramid Optimization: Drive the overarching test strategy by mapping product functionalities to the software development lifecycle (SDLC). Push testing to the bottom of the test pyramid for earlier detection.
* Multi-Layered Coverage: Architect a comprehensive validation strategy spanning from low-level Component Test Specification (CTS) coverage, through the Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) layer, up to final physical machine testing.
* Software Performance Validation: Proactively strategize, monitor, and validate against critical software failure modes, specifically focusing on system performance metrics like network bus loads and CPU loads.
* V&V Best Practices: Establish and enforce standard V&V processes, including rigorous test plan and result reviews, effective machine-test time planning, design margin testing, and driving exploratory testing initiatives.
* Standardized Documentation & Training: Drive the use of Design Verification Plan & Report (DVP&R) and Risk-Based Thinking. Educate product teams and mentor validation engineers on key processes, venues, and validation expectations.

**Tools & Environments**

* HIL Simulation & Execution: Execute and oversee complex Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) validation using tools such as dSPACE (harnessing, modeling, and execution), Vector tools, Simulink, and Stateflow.
* API & Automation Frameworks: Design, develop, and maintain automated API verification frameworks using modern testing tools like Playwright and Postman.
* Next-Gen QA & AI: Leverage AI agentic QA tools and extensive automation experience to drive continuous improvement, speed, and efficiency in the software validation pipeline.
* Innovative Machine Simulation: Innovate and develop new, effective ways to simulate complex machine setups in lab environments to supplement and enhance physical testing.
* Hands-On Machine & Environmental Testing: Apply hands-on machine testing experience to practically evaluate product performance in real-world environments, alongside executing environmental and performance lab tests.
